value.title: Missed Reliance Industries’ historic 8% one-day rally? Here’s what technical analysts are saying
value.summary: Reliance Industries shares surged on Monday, marking their sharpest single-day rally in nearly seven years and adding Rs 1 lakh crore to its market capitalisation, taking it to Rs 17 lakh crore. The rally followed strong Q2 FY27 results, with consolidated net profit rising 41% year-on-year to Rs 25,548 crore and revenue growing 29% to Rs 3.32 lakh crore. The oil-to-chemicals segment led earnings growth, with EBITDA jumping 68% to a record Rs 25,203 crore.

value.title: Dixon Technologies shares gain 11% after Q2 revenue jumps 47% YoY

However, net profit fell 48.7% to Rs 343.7 crore, while EBITDA declined 37% to Rs 666 crore. EBITDA margin contracted to 3.1% from 7.1% a year ago, despite higher revenue and operating profit growth.

value.title: Reliance Industries shares set for biggest-single day jump since April 2020 as Q2 earnings spark Rs 1 lakh crore rally
value.summary: Reliance Industries shares surged nearly 7.5% after reporting outstanding Q2 results for FY27. The company announced a massive 41% yearly increase in net profit to Rs 25,548 crore, alongside a 29% rise in revenue to Rs 3.32 lakh crore. value.title: Lodha Developers profit rises 28% YoY to Rs 1,013 crore in Sept quarter
value.summary: Lodha has announced a remarkable 63% surge in net profit, reaching ₹2,386 crore for the first half of FY27. This growth is driven by impressive operational performance, with net profit for the September quarter rising by 28% to ₹1,013 crore and revenue climbing 18% to ₹4,468 crore. The company’s pre-sales also saw a 10% increase to ₹5,037 crore, alongside plans for expansion in NCR and Bengaluru.

value.title: Varun Beverages Q3 net profit rises 13% YoY, but margins fall
value.summary: Varun Beverages recorded a substantial net profit increase of 13.5% for the quarter ending September 2026. Although there was strong revenue growth attributed to both local and international sales, the company's shares dropped because of shrinking operating margins. Challenges arose from heightened packaging costs and sugar price surges affecting gross margins. Additionally, Varun Beverages solidified its partnership with PepsiCo, extending their licensing agreement through 2049.

value.title: Oil-to-chemicals business powers Reliance Industries' record quarterly net profit, up 34% to ₹29,550 crore

With a yearly revenue surge of 28.5% to ₹3.38 lakh crore, the O2C division's Ebitda skyrocketed 68%, reflecting the advantages of elevated energy prices and the firm’s adaptability in challenging market scenarios.

value.title: Syrma SGS reports best-ever quarter; Q2 revenue up 73% to Rs 1,999.5 crore

Investments are planned in collaboration with Kaga Electronics to enhance the domestic supply ecosystem.
